messages:
jess_supp: Heads-up — customer on Private deployment reporting streaming websocket connections get cut after ~60s of silence. Hosted works fine. They say responses buffer and then a chunked flush with no close frame. Repro steps from them: wscat to our private endpoint, start streaming, pause for 70s, then connection drops. No error in app logs.

maria_infra: Thanks. Which customer and region? Any LB in front (ALB/NLB) or a customer-managed proxy?

jess_supp: ACME Corp in us-west-2. Private deployment behind their NGFW + internal nginx (customer-managed). They confirmed corporate firewall but said it's allowed.

sam_runtime: Common pattern: middlebox idle timeout (AWS ALB default 60s) or proxy buffering/breaking websocket keepalive. Can you get tcpdump or app-level close reason? If their nginx is proxying websocket incorrectly it may buffer until it forces a close.

jess_supp: I grabbed a tcpdump they sent. snippet: 
```
14:22:01.123456 IP 10.0.0.5.52344 > 10.0.1.10.443: Flags [P.], seq 1:256, ack 1, win 229, length 255
14:23:02.123789 IP 10.0.1.10.443 > 10.0.0.5.52344: RST, seq 0, win 0, length 0
```
They see RST from 10.0.1.10 (their edge). No TLS alerts in our logs.

tony_net: RST from their edge implies middlebox actively killing the TCP. Could be idle TCP timeout or an inspection device closing. Ask them to check idle timeouts on their NGFW/IDS. Also check any TCP proxy that terminates TLS and re-establishes; SNI mismatches can cause renegotiation and drop.

maria_infra: Workaround options: (1) enable application-level websocket pings or ping_interval on client to keep connection active, (2) set proxy_read_timeout on nginx to something > expected idle window and disable buffering: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade; proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade; proxy_read_timeout 3600s;` (3) if using AWS ALB, increase idle timeout (default 60s) to e.g., 300+ seconds, (4) if middlebox is non-configurable, use short-lived chunked responses or frequent small heartbeats.

jess_supp: Sent them the nginx snippet and suggested ALB check. They replied they don't have ALB but a F5 load balancer with 60s idle.

sam_runtime: F5s often have TCP idle close for long-lived websockets. F5 config options: TCP profile -> Idle Timeout, or set HTTP/1.1 keepalive; also enable Websocket profile if available. Otherwise app-level pings are the only reliable fix.

jess_supp: They tested with wscat using `--ping-interval 30` and said stable for 10+ minutes. So ping workaround works. But they want permanent fix in infra.

maria_infra: Agreed. For Private docs we should add KB: "Websocket disconnects in Private deployments" detailing ALB/F5/NGFW idle timeouts, proxy_buffering off, and app ping recommendations. Also include tcpdump signs (RST w/ no FIN, no TLS alert) and nginx config snippet.

tony_net: Also flagged potential TLS inspection cause — if their NGFW does TLS MITM it may rekey and drop. Ask them to confirm certificate passthrough vs termination. If termination, ensure SNI preserved and that backend TLS session reuse is correct.

infra-bot: config-change: maria_infra applied a draft KB entry to /kb/internal/ws-private-timeouts — please review.

jess_supp: I'll follow up with ACME and offer a support call to walk through their F5/nginx settings. Marking this thread as "in progress" — workaround: enable websocket pings or increase idle timeout on load balancer/proxy.

sam_runtime: One extra note for our runtime: consider lowering server-side keepalive probe interval and sending occasional nops on idle websockets when client hasn't sent data for X seconds. Filing follow-up GH issue to discuss adaptive keepalive.

jess_supp: Thanks all. I'll update when customer confirms permanent change. :thumbsup:
